about.label: About Me
about.heading: I'm Alex, nice to meet you
about.p1: I've been building websites and bots for a few years now. Some I make for clients, some for myself. The biggest one I'm proud of is <link>English Nerd</link>, a free English learning platform I built from scratch, both as the developer and the teacher behind the content.
about.p2: Before code, I taught English. I still do. That background shows up in my work: I care about the details, explain things clearly, and notice when something on a page makes you stop and squint.
about.p3: I speak five languages, I've lived in seven countries, and I'm currently in Poznan. Most clients find me through word of mouth.
